nodes.summary: Shared HLSL constants for WVP, 128-bone skinning, and the material buffer used by 3D vertex and pixel shaders.

nodes.name: SkyboxPS.hlsl
nodes.summary: Skybox pixel shader that samples a cubemap along the view direction and applies tint plus exposure.

nodes.name: SkyboxVS.hlsl
nodes.summary: Skybox vertex shader that rotates the cube, projects with z=w so the sky stays at the far plane.

nodes.name: VertexShader2D.hlsl
nodes.summary: 2D vertex shader that transforms local positions by a world matrix and a combined view-projection matrix.

nodes.name: VertexShader3D.hlsl
nodes.summary: Standard 3D vertex shader that projects object-space positions through WorldViewProjection and forwards lighting interpolants.

nodes.name: VertexShader3DSkinned.hlsl
nodes.summary: Skinned 3D vertex shader that blends bone-weighted positions with SkinPositionOS before the WorldViewProjection transform.

nodes.name: VertexShader3D_Outline.hlsl
nodes.summary: Outline-pass vertex shader that skins a mesh then extrudes clip-space XY along the projected normal for a screen-consistent toon silhouette.

nodes.name: VertexShaderUnlit.hlsl
nodes.summary: Billboard and ground-decal vertex shader that builds camera-facing or XZ-aligned quads with rotation, atlas UVs, and per-instance color.

nodes.name: WICTextureLoader11.cpp
nodes.summary: Microsoft WIC-to-D3D11 texture loader that converts pixel formats, optionally resizes to power-of-two, and creates textures with mip generation.

nodes.name: WICTextureLoader11.h
nodes.summary: Public DirectX WIC texture-loader API declaring memory and file overloads plus WIC_LOADER_FLAGS for sRGB, resize, and RGBA32 forcing.

nodes.name: assemble_api_reference.py
nodes.summary: Builds docs/ENGINE_API_REFERENCE.md by wrapping the extracted header catalog in a capability-overview intro template.

nodes.name: build_fbx_stats.bat
nodes.summary: Compiles tools/fbx_stats.cpp against the FBX SDK with MSVC and copies libfbxsdk.dll into tools/bin.

nodes.name: extract_api_headers.py
nodes.summary: Scans engine/ and src/app/ headers for declarations, enums, and macros, writes docs/_api_extract.md, then runs the API reference assembler.

nodes.name: fbx_stats.cpp
nodes.summary: Command-line FBX inspector that prints mesh, skin, and cluster counts and verifies Autodesk matrix-multiply conventions.

nodes.name: generate_default_sky_cubemap.py
nodes.summary: Writes a 64-pixel RGBA DDS cubemap with simple sky gradients used as the engine default sky texture.

layers.name: Application Hosts

layers.name: Editor
layers.description: ImGui editor panels, viewport gizmos, undo, project browser, asset indexing, and playable-package export used by the editor host.

layers.name: ECS and Scene
layers.description: GameObject ECS components and systems plus scene load, runtime, lighting, camera, and node graph shared by both engine hosts.

layers.name: Rendering
layers.description: Direct3D 11 renderer, models, lighting, shadows, particles, Effekseer effects, sprites, skybox, and HLSL GPU programs.

layers.name: Simulation
layers.description: Rigidbody physics and colliders, listener-synced audio, and keyboard, mouse, and controller input devices.

layers.name: Scripting
layers.description: Hot-reload GameScripts.dll surface: script components, factories, DLL exports, runtime API, file watcher, and sample gameplay scripts.

layers.name: Runtime UI
layers.description: In-game canvas, buttons, sprites, fonts, and UI script hosting that games draw in the scene, distinct from the ImGui editor.

layers.name: Engine Core
layers.description: Job system, timers, easing, debug draw, frame transform snapshots, ImGui engine shell, and precompiled headers used across subsystems.

layers.name: Content and Assets
layers.description: Shipped ROM effects, skyboxes, scene JSON, editor prefs, tags, and sample playground scenes loaded at runtime.

layers.name: Project Support
layers.description: Solution and MSBuild files, architecture docs and ADRs, developer tools, and the external content-project template for GameScripts.dll.
